Gold.note: Central bank accumulation and rate cut expectations support momentum.

Silver.note: Industrial solar demand and gold-silver ratio compression drive outperformance.

Copper.note: Structural mine supply deficits and global electrification demand.

Uranium.note: Nuclear renaissance and tightening long-term utility contracts.

Lithium.note: Persistent supply surplus from new projects outweighs EV demand growth.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply growth continues to outpace EV battery demand.

Zinc.note: Mine closures and low treatment charges signal tight concentrate supply.

Iron Ore.note: Softening Chinese property sector steel demand and high port inventories.

Coal.note: Peak thermal demand passing and structural transition to renewables.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical export curbs offset by weak global EV motor demand.

Manganese.note: Oversupply in steel-grade and slow commercialization of high-manganese batteries.

PGM.note: Substitution effects and structural decline in internal combustion engine sales.

Potash.note: Normalizing global supply chains and adequate agricultural application rates.

Aluminum.note: Chinese smelter curtailments and strong renewable energy frame demand.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to base metals and iron ore provides macro hedging.
